Name: Overhauled Four Corners Farm
Author: Priff13
Description:
Expands the original farm to include four distinct "regions" that mimic other farm types such as: Hilltop, Riverland & Beach, Standard, and Forest.
All regions have distinct advantages and disadvantages that correspond with their respective farm maps.
This includes, but not limited to, Beach farm forage, respawning stumps, mini quarry, fractured landscape, and dense foliage.
It supports up to 8 players, each region having a total of 2 separate houses or cabins in it.

The rest is up for you to discover!

This mod requires Stardew Valley 1.6.0+
